s1.text: Five years. Keep your own test records.

s2.text: Myth: the factory keeps them. The certifier does, usually the importer.

s3.text: Certificates and the test records behind them, for at least five years.

s4.text: Say the certifier only has the PDF. The test records sit at the factory.

s5.text: Blocked right now? Forward the notice. Get your gap list in twenty-four hours.
